name: bike-shops-lead-finder
description: A lightweight Node.js API built with **Express**, **Puppeteer**, **Axios**, and **Cheerio** designed to be called by **n8n** (or any HTTP client). It scrapes business listings from Google Maps by city/state/keyword, visits each business's website to extract email addresses and social media links, and verifies email deliverability via DNS `MX` record lookups.
